title: CodeJam Track #5 v2 — Agent Middleware Challenge (3-Day Undergraduate Edition)
h1: Agent Launchpad: Make a Working Agent Platform Production-Shaped

callout.p: Audience: second- and third-year undergraduates · Duration: 3 days · Rule: choose exactly one middleware track.

The organizers provide a one-line local Docker/Colima/Podman + Codex CLI + Ark Starter Kit, with optional Volcengine ECS deployment. Your team improves one middleware layer instead of rebuilding the platform.
